$scope: Flood only. No landslide states, triggers, or actions exist in this file by design (hard constraint).
$doNotClaim: This file does not represent a live or predictive system.
No entry in this file authorizes TerraCascade to issue a public order, open a gate, or send an alert. Every 'red' action is a drafted recommendation for human authorisation.

playbook.label: Blue flood/EAP state
productAction: Display flood-extent layer with source/status/limitations label for the configured watch scenario
Log internal-notification entry to EOC duty officer — no external or public communication
playbook.authorityBoundary: No external or public order may be issued at Blue. Product surfaces monitoring and an internal checklist only; it does not notify anyone outside KSEB.

protocolSource.section: Alert Level 1 / Blue (Watch) — exact section/clause number not yet verified against the source document

playbook.label: Orange flood/EAP state
productAction: Run impact review against the configured controlled-release scenario
Publish hourly internal update to KSEB and District EOC
Surface coordination-readiness checklist (contact lists, staging status) for review
playbook.authorityBoundary: Product surfaces impact-review data and a readiness checklist only. EPM or the authorised chain decides any coordination or release action — TerraCascade does not decide or trigger releases.

protocolSource.section: Alert Level 2 / Orange (Warning) — exact section/clause number not yet verified against the source document

playbook.label: Red flood/EAP state
productAction: Generate an immediate-evacuation recommendation for District Authority review
Draft public-alert content marked 'draft for authorised publication'
Flag the scenario for District Authority escalation and log the override/approval trail
playbook.authorityBoundary: Product drafts a recommendation and alert text only. Publication and any evacuation order require Collector or authorised-communicator sign-off. TerraCascade does not send alerts, order evacuations, or control gates.
